RESTAURANT-FULL.label: Full-Service Restaurant (with alcohol)
RESTAURANT-FULL.description: Sit-down restaurant serving food and alcoholic beverages on premises.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Liquor Liability frequently omitted from submissions despite alcohol sales
Assault & Battery exclusion is standard and should be disclosed
Grease/fire exposure requires Property coverage with cooking-equipment endorsement
RESTAURANT-FULL.notes: Loss history involving slip-and-fall or liquor-related incidents materially raises risk.

RESTAURANT-QSR.label: Quick-Service Restaurant (no alcohol)
RESTAURANT-QSR.description: Counter-service or fast-food restaurant, no alcohol sales.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Liquor Liability not applicable — requesting it is a mismatch worth flagging
High employee turnover raises Workers Comp exposure
RESTAURANT-QSR.notes: Lower severity exposure than full-service with alcohol.

BAR-NIGHTCLUB.label: Bar / Nightclub
BAR-NIGHTCLUB.description: Establishment primarily serving alcohol, often with live entertainment or dancing.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Liquor Liability is mandatory, not optional, for this class
Assault & Battery and Abuse/Molestation exclusions are standard and high-relevance
Occupancy over stated capacity is a frequent hidden exposure
BAR-NIGHTCLUB.notes: Highest-severity hospitality class; any liquor liability gap is a hard flag.

RETAIL-APPAREL.label: Retail – Apparel / General Merchandise
RETAIL-APPAREL.description: Storefront retail selling clothing or general merchandise, no food/alcohol.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Product Liability relevant only if store also manufactures/private-labels goods
Shoplifting/inventory shrinkage is a Crime coverage consideration, not GL
RETAIL-APPAREL.notes: Generally low-severity class relative to hospitality or construction.

CONTRACTOR-GENERAL.label: General Contractor (commercial construction)
CONTRACTOR-GENERAL.description: Manages/performs commercial construction projects, may use subcontractors.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Subcontractor use without Additional Insured / Certificate tracking is a major gap
Completed Operations exclusion or sub-limit is a red flag for this class
No Umbrella/Excess requested despite large project size is a mismatch
CONTRACTOR-GENERAL.notes: High severity class; requires Umbrella for projects over ~$2M revenue.

CONTRACTOR-ROOFING.label: Roofing Contractor
CONTRACTOR-ROOFING.description: Specialty trade contractor performing roof installation/repair, height exposure.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Roofing is a restricted/high-hazard trade — many carriers exclude or sublimit it
Height-related falls dominate loss history for this class
Subcontracted roofing work without Additional Insured status is a hard flag
CONTRACTOR-ROOFING.notes: One of the highest Workers Compensation severity classes in construction.

TECH-SAAS-OFFICE.label: Technology / SaaS – Office Only
TECH-SAAS-OFFICE.description: Software company, office-based, no manufacturing or physical product.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Cyber Liability commonly omitted despite being the primary exposure for this class
Tech E&O relevant if the company provides software/services to clients
TECH-SAAS-OFFICE.notes: Low physical-injury severity; risk concentrated in data/cyber and professional liability.

TRUCKING-FREIGHT.label: Trucking / Freight Transportation
TRUCKING-FREIGHT.description: Motor carrier hauling freight, owns or leases commercial vehicles.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Commercial Auto Liability is mandatory — absence is a hard flag
Cargo coverage limit should scale with typical load value
Driver safety/loss history is the dominant underwriting factor
TRUCKING-FREIGHT.notes: High-severity auto exposure class; loss history weighs heavily.

MANUFACTURING-LIGHT.label: Light Manufacturing (non-hazardous materials)
MANUFACTURING-LIGHT.description: Assembles or fabricates goods from non-hazardous materials.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Product Liability is essential for this class; requesting only premises GL is a gap
Machinery-related injury dominates Workers Comp loss history
MANUFACTURING-LIGHT.notes: Moderate severity; varies significantly with materials/process specifics.

PROPERTY-MGMT.label: Real Estate / Property Management
PROPERTY-MGMT.description: Manages residential or commercial rental properties for owners.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: E&O is important given fiduciary/management duties to property owners
Habitability/maintenance-related claims are the dominant loss driver
PROPERTY-MGMT.notes: Severity scales with number and type of managed units.

CHILDCARE-DAYCARE.label: Childcare / Daycare Facility
CHILDCARE-DAYCARE.description: Licensed facility providing care for children.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Abuse/Molestation Liability is mandatory for this class — absence is a hard flag
Staff-to-child ratio and background-check practices are key underwriting factors
CHILDCARE-DAYCARE.notes: One of the highest-scrutiny classes; any coverage gap here is treated as severe.

AUTO-REPAIR-GARAGE.label: Auto Repair / Garage
AUTO-REPAIR-GARAGE.description: Repairs or services motor vehicles for customers.
common_exclusions_or_red_flags: Garagekeepers Liability (care/custody/control of customer vehicles) is essential and often omitted
On-site test drives require Garage Liability auto exposure, not just premises GL
AUTO-REPAIR-GARAGE.notes: Custody of customer property is the defining exposure for this class.
